messages:
alex.c: Heads-up — we need a concrete per-route KPI layout for Console that includes token-level latency slices (p50/p95/p99), throughput, and error rate. Current dashboards hide kernel and KV impacts so SREs can't triage regressions quickly.
maria.p: +1. Can we avoid exploding cardinality? route_id x model_variant x kernel x kv_hit sounds painful in metrics volume.
jordan.l: We should use histogram buckets for token latency and derive pXX from the histogram instead of storing every quantile. label set: route_id, model_family, kernel_tag, kv_hit(boolean). keep batch_size out of high-cardinality tags (sample it).
sam.r: For debugging regressions I'd like a waterfall view that shows: enqueue -> batch_wait -> kernel_exec -> kv_lookup -> postproc. Token-level breakdown for a sampled subset (1%) to keep cost down.
priya.k: Agree on sampling. Also need an aggregated per-route KPI panel with: p50/p95/p99 token-latency, tokens/sec, requests/sec, error_rate(5m), 99th tail error_count. Add traffic-weighted baseline so smaller routes don't drown in alerts.
alex.c: Thinking about storage: primary metrics in Prometheus (histograms + counters) for realtime, and ClickHouse for granular token traces and profiling exports. Perf-bot and tracing will post into ClickHouse.
perf-bot: perf-bot: new profiling export available for 1782003200-1782003400 window. 12k requests, 2.1M tokens. KV hit rate 72%.
maria.p: We need to surface kernel selection frequency per route: e.g., cuda-attn-v2 used 83% vs fallback cpu-gemm 17%. If a regression flips this, on-call should see it in the route row.
jordan.l: Proposal for Console grid: rows = routes; columns = p50, p95, p99 (ms), tokens/sec, reqs/sec, error_rate, kv_hit%, top_kernel, recent_regressions(link). Each cell links to a detail view with sampled token waterfalls and example profiles.
sam.r: For the waterfall detail, sample 50 traces per route per hour. Display stacked bar per-token with colors: enqueue(batch_time), kv_lookup(ms), kernel_exec(ms), kv_write, postproc. Allow toggling log scale.
priya.k: Alerts: route-level SLA breaches when p95 > threshold for 5m and error_rate > 1% for 3m. Also a stealth alert when kernel mix shifts by >20% and correlates with latency increase.
alex.c: Implementation notes — backend metric names: ri_route_token_latency_bucket{route=...,kernel=...,kv_hit=..}. ri_route_request_count total. ri_route_kernel_switch_event counter. Avoid labels with freeform strings; normalize kernel tags.
maria.p: Example PromQL for p95 derived from histogram: 
  histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ri_route_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
Keep le buckets aligned to token latency (1ms..2000ms).
jordan.l: ClickHouse query for sampled token waterfall (approx): 
  SELECT route, token_index, sum(kernel_ms) as kernel_ms, sum(kv_ms) as kv_ms FROM perf_traces WHERE route='chat-complete' AND ts between X and Y GROUP BY token_index ORDER BY token_index
We can serve this as a pre-aggregated view.
sam.r: UX request — show a tiny inline sparkline of p95 over 6h in the route list and a colored dot if recent kernel switch/regression detected.
priya.k: On costs — estimate: histograms (low cardinality) + sampled traces (1% or 50 traces/hr) keeps TCO decent. We should embargo full-cardinality route+model+kernel tagging until we have compression and retention policy.
alex.c: Action items: 1) eng-runtime to land histogram instrumentation and kernel tags (sam + jordan) 2) eng-platform to add backend views in ClickHouse and Prometheus mapping (maria) 3) devex to design Console grid + waterfall UX (priya) 4) SRE to draft alert thresholds (sam). I'll open PRs and a followup thread with concrete query examples.
maria.p: I'll start a PR for the prometheus metric names and bucket set.
jordan.l: I'll add kernel selector telemetry hooks to runtime and mark them as low-cardinality tokens.
sam.r: I'll draft alert runbook and add a sample p95 threshold table for common model families.
priya.k: I'll mock the grid and waterfall in Figma, include both condensed and expanded views.
perf-bot: perf-bot: dashboard draft deployed to staging: /staging/console/kpi-route-grid — expect data lag ~30s for histograms.
alex.c: Great — let's iterate on staging dashboards. If anyone finds a perf regression during smoke, post trace ids here. :eyes:
